  reg prev_din;

    if (!rst_n) begin
      count <= 3'd0;
      state <= 1'b0;

          state <= 1'b1;
        end
      end else begin
        count <= 3'd0;
        state <= 1'b0;
      end
    end
  end
  
  assign dout = (state == 1'b1) ? 1'b0 : din;
  assign stuffed = state;

endmodule
